component.name: Plezilo
component.summary: Watch and listen to your Plex, Jellyfin, Emby and Silo libraries

description.p: Plezilo is a media client for Plex, Jellyfin, Emby and Silo servers. Browse your libraries, stream video and music, and download media for offline playback.
Playback uses MPV with support for subtitles, multiple audio tracks, playback speed controls, and hardware video decoding on supported systems.
Plezilo is based on the open-source Plezy client. It is a separate app and is not made or endorsed by the Plezy project.
